mapper.select: SELECT a.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name FROM applications a JOIN positions p ON a.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON a.student_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name, u.number AS student_number, u.class_name AS student_class_name, u.email AS student_email, u.phone AS student_phone FROM applications a JOIN positions p ON a.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON a.student_id = u.id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC

SELECT a.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name, u.number AS student_number, u.class_name AS student_class_name, u.email AS student_email, u.phone AS student_phone FROM applications a JOIN positions p ON a.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON a.student_id = u.id WHERE a.position_id = #{positionId} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC

SELECT a.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name FROM applications a JOIN positions p ON a.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON a.student_id = u.id WHERE a.position_id = #{positionId} AND a.status = 'approved' ORDER BY a.applied_at ASC
